verdict.rationale: Docs and community reports consistently confirm Gitea is a lightweight, single-binary/Docker-deployable Git server with no complex dependencies, running well even on low-resource VPS/hardware (gitea-docs-9, gitea-docs-23, gitea-comm-1, gitea-comm-6, gitea-comm-8, gitea-comm-14, gitea-comm-18). Some real-world caveats exist (documentation gaps, occasional migration friction) but these are minor relative to the core low-effort setup claim. Missing for 10: more rigorous independent benchmarking of install time/complexity and resolution of noted documentation/migration friction.
